description: This file provides a polyfill implementation of bit manipulation operations, including log2, counting trailing zeros, and rounding up to power of two for .NET versions earlier than 3.1. It defines a static class 'BitOperations' with methods optimized for performance using de Bruijn sequences and unsafe code, used within the Orleans.Serialization.Utilities namespace.

classes.name: BitOperations
classes.description: A static class providing bit manipulation utilities such as calculating log base 2, counting trailing zeros, and rounding up to the nearest power of two, with implementations optimized for various .NET runtimes.

methods.name: Log2
methods.description: Computes the floor of the base-2 logarithm for a uint value, adjusting for zero input by returning 0.

methods.name: Log2
methods.description: Computes the floor of the base-2 logarithm for an ulong value, handling high and low parts separately.

methods.name: TrailingZeroCount
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in a uint value, using a de Bruijn sequence for efficiency.

methods.name: TrailingZeroCount
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zero bits in a ulong value, combining results from low and high 32-bit parts.

methods.name: RoundUpToPowerOf2
methods.description: Rounds a uint value up to the nearest power of two; if input is zero or overflow occurs, returns zero.
